cc:Work.dc:title: Agentic AI: experimentation and scaling
cc:Work.dc:description: Reported organizational adoption; 1,993 respondents in 105 nations, GDP-weighted. Scaling means at least one function, not enterprise-wide deployment. Historical self-reported survey data; not a 2026 adoption estimate.
